prompt.en: A basket rises from 1,000 to 1,100 and savings stay at 1,000. What can savings buy?
prompt.sw: Kikapu kinapanda kutoka 1,000 hadi 1,100 na akiba inabaki 1,000. Inanunua kiasi gani?

explanation.en: Divide the unchanged balance by the new basket price: 1,000 / 1,100.
explanation.sw: Gawa salio lisilobadilika kwa bei mpya: 1,000 / 1,100.

prompt.en: Savings grow 5% while the basket rises 10%. What is the approximate real change?
prompt.sw: Akiba inaongezeka 5% huku kikapu kikipanda 10%. Mabadiliko halisi ni yapi?

explanation.en: Use 1.05 / 1.10 - 1. Simple subtraction is only an approximation.
explanation.sw: Tumia 1.05 / 1.10 - 1. Kutoa asilimia moja katika nyingine ni makadirio tu.

label.en: Inflation compares a price basket; depreciation compares currencies
label.sw: Mfumuko hulinganisha kikapu cha bei; kushuka kwa sarafu hulinganisha sarafu
Vyote hupima utoaji wa Bitcoin pekee

explanation.en: Exchange-rate movements can affect prices but are not the same measurement.
explanation.sw: Mabadiliko ya ubadilishaji yanaweza kuathiri bei lakini si kipimo kilekile.

prompt.en: Does limited Bitcoin issuance guarantee more food for your sats later?
prompt.sw: Kikomo cha utoaji wa Bitcoin kinahakikisha sats zako zitanunua chakula zaidi baadaye?

label.en: No; market demand and food prices remain uncertain
label.sw: Hapana; mahitaji ya soko na bei za chakula bado hazina uhakika

label.en: Yes, after any fixed number of years
label.sw: Ndiyo, baada ya idadi fulani ya miaka

explanation.en: A supply rule is not a purchasing-power or investment-return guarantee.
explanation.sw: Kanuni ya utoaji si dhamana ya uwezo wa kununua wala faida.
